$comment: Lumos BLE advertisement hint, TRS Sec. 9.3 as replaced by ADR-002. Binary layout description, not JSON Schema. THIS PAYLOAD IS AN UNAUTHENTICATED ROUTING HINT. Nothing here may be trusted: peer EID, capabilities, protocol version and venue context are (re)established inside the authenticated GATT HELLO/HELLO_ACK (TRS-PROTO-017). Presence dedup and aging key on authenticated post-handshake identity, so a hintless peer - every iOS peer, and any Android peer in degraded mode - behaves identically in the Nearby feed.

service_identity.note: One fixed 128-bit GATT service UUID, advertised by both platforms and used for scan filtering. No 16-bit alias is registered for flagship.

android_degraded.note: If an OEM stack rejects the service-data combination, the adapter degrades to UUID-only advertising identical to iOS. This is a SUPPORTED MODE, not an error, and must not be reported as a failure.

ios.note: CoreBluetooth cannot advertise arbitrary service or manufacturer data. No EID on air. Never attempt service-data advertising on iOS, and never work around this with a private API. Discoverability of a backgrounded iPhone by an Android scanner is NOT promised (TRS-PROTO-018).

fields.name: auth_tag
fields.derivation: First ADV_AUTH_TAG_LEN bytes of HMAC-SHA-256(K_adv, version | mode_flags | rotating_eid | epoch)
fields.purpose: Cheap pre-connection noise rejection on Android only. It is NOT authentication and confers no trust.

prohibited_content.rule: No alias, photo, gender, orientation, phone number, exact location or persistent store account ID is permitted in any advertisement or scan response.
prohibited_content.enforcement: Fields are fixed-width and enumerated above; the layout admits no free-form area in which such data could be carried.
